units.source_text: 第二个问题是，我为什么要写这样的日记呢？

en.t: The second question is: why did I write a diary like this?

units.source_text: 无疑是因为觉得祖父临终了，我想把祖父的形象记录下来。

en.t: No doubt it was because I felt my grandfather was near death, and I wanted to record his image.

units.source_text: 十六岁的我，竟在一个弥留的病人身旁记了这些写生式的日记，后来回想起来也觉着奇怪。

en.t: That I, at sixteen, should have kept these sketch-like diary entries beside a dying patient seems strange even when I think back on it later.
